title: Validate values against a compact field schema
prompt: Implement and export validateSchema in src/validate-schema.js. Signature: validateSchema(schema, value) returns true when value satisfies schema and false otherwise; it never throws because of value. A malformed schema throws TypeError. schema must be a non-null, non-array object. Each own key is a field name and its value is a descriptor object with only these allowed keys: type, required, minLength, maxLength, min, max, enum. type is required and must be one of 'string', 'number', 'boolean'. required is an optional boolean and defaults to true. minLength and maxLength are optional safe integers greater than or equal to 0 and are allowed only for type 'string'; when both are given, minLength <= maxLength. min and max are optional finite numbers and are allowed only for type 'number'; when both are given, min <= max. enum is an optional non-empty array whose entries must match the descriptor type ('string' entries for string, finite 'number' entries for number, 'boolean' entries for boolean); membership is tested with Object.is. Any other descriptor shape, unknown descriptor key, wrong constraint type, constraint on the wrong type, or empty enum is a malformed schema and throws TypeError. value must be a non-null, non-array object; otherwise the result is false (even for an empty schema). For each schema field, the field is present only when value has it as an own property with a value other than undefined. A missing field is valid only when required is false. A present field must satisfy its type: typeof 'string' for string; typeof 'number' and Number.isFinite for number; typeof 'boolean' for boolean. When the type matches, maxLength and minLength apply inclusively to the string length, min and max apply inclusively to the number, and enum applies if present. Extra fields not listed in the schema are allowed and ignored. Do not mutate schema or value. Keep the existing export.
